findings.issue: The 'View details' link at [link:8:c4d5e6f7-a8b9-0123-cdef-456789012345] lacks context about which product it refers to. Screen reader users navigating by links hear 'View details, link' repeatedly without knowing which item each link belongs to.

evidence.pattern: Multiple 'View details' links appear consecutively without distinguishing context

stepsToReproduce: Press K to navigate to the first 'View details' link
Note that NVDA announces 'View details, link' with no product context
Press K again to reach the next link
Notice the same announcement repeats, making it impossible to distinguish between products
findings.impact: Users browsing by links (pressing K or using the Elements List) cannot determine which product each 'View details' link refers to without navigating back to read surrounding content.
findings.semanticJustification: Rules detected duplicate link text but cannot assess whether the surrounding visual context (product cards) provides sufficient disambiguation. In this case, the links appear in a flat list when navigating by K key, losing all product context.

majorConcerns: Heading hierarchy skip from H1 to H3 disrupts document outline - see [heading-level-skipped:heading-level-skipped-a1b2c3d4]
Generic 'Click here' and 'View details' links lack descriptive context for screen reader users

limitations: Cannot verify visual layout or spacing between elements
Cannot assess color contrast beyond what axe-core reported
Cannot determine if product images convey essential information not in text

enhancements.severityRationale: Moderate impact. Users navigating by heading level (pressing 2 for H2s) will miss product names entirely since they jump from H2 category titles to H2 reviews, skipping the H3 product headings. However, users pressing H for all headings will still encounter the content.
enhancements.remediationSuggestion:
Change product name headings from H3 to H2, or add H2 section headings before product listings (e.g., '

Products in Women's Dresses

').
enhancements.userImpactDescription: Screen reader users pressing '2' to jump between H2 headings will skip over all product names, going directly from category titles to 'Customer Reviews'.

enhancements.severityRationale: Serious impact. When users list all links on the page (NVDA+F7), 'Click here' provides zero information about the destination. This is a sale promotion link that users interested in discounts would want to find quickly.
enhancements.remediationSuggestion: Change link text to describe the destination: 'Shop the Summer Sale' or use aria-label: 'Click here'.
enhancements.userImpactDescription: Users cannot identify this as the sale page link when browsing the links list. They must navigate to it and explore surrounding content to understand its purpose.
